plan.reason: With only 24 of 100 evaluations used and 20 stagnant steps with zero recent improvement, the search needs more exploration to escape a flat/plateau region. auto lets held-out RMSE pick RBF vs quadratic given sparse 5-D data; current_to_best balances convergence with diversity. Moderate mutation (0.6) and high crossover (0.85) for recombination, elevated exploration (0.45) to reward novelty distance, and local_fraction 0.35/radius 0.15 for a light local refinement without over-exploiting a possibly misleading surrogate. Population 30 and 6 generations keep surrogate re-fits and true-evaluation batches economical within the fixed budget.
